fields.statement: Verifier at b3d3cab3 (attempt 2, fixer commit adding planOwnerRefuses/planOwnerJournaled in internal/api/run.go). Read the diff: run start refuses --autonomous with a usage error naming workflow plan-milestone and where its declaration was read when the resolved plan workflow declares the plan stage owner (both the --new path and the record change set path), and run resume refuses a run journaled autonomous whose plan stage is owner. Ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(plan-milestone-workflow|run-start-milestone-autonomous|workflow-ls|daemon-milestone-request|plan-workflow-autonomous|plan-workflow-autonomous-left|workflow-plan-autonomy|workflow-stage-autonomy|plan-run-milestone-env|plan-workflow|describe-golden)$': ok, with fake rex and no real agents. plan-milestone-workflow.txtar shows workflow ls listing plan-milestone as builtin:plan-milestone; under rhiza.autonomy.plan=auto, a milestone request's daemon start runs --workflow plan-milestone without --autonomous; and a repo plan-milestone.toml with autonomous = true makes the daemon pass --autonomous. run-start-milestone-autonomous.txtar shows the exit-2 refusals that name builtin:plan-milestone and write no draft or journal, the repo-file override, resume refused 'as run X journaled it' (the journal records workflow plan-milestone; run.go:661 journals def.Name/WorkflowPath after milestonePlanWorkflow swaps in builtin:plan-milestone), and autonomous = true lifting the refusal. go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... ok (TestBuiltinPlanMilestone: plan-milestone steps equal plan's, every stage owner). go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'Milestone|RunStart|RunResume|PlanRun|Autonom' ok. A full internal/api package run hit the 600s go test timeout at VM load ~30 and was not completed; CI runs it.
